identify: Mirid nymphs look like aphids but they move much faster.
The adults and nymphs have long and thin antennae.
damage: Feeding kills the plant tips of young plants. Fed squares dry and fall. Fed bolls show sunken black spots and the seeds are shrunken and stained.

cultural: Check the plant tips and squares often.
biological: Protect lady beetles and lacewings in the field.
